audience: customer success teams that collect surveys and reviews with Trustmary

useCases.title: Check the connected review sources
useCases.text: List the review connections, which are the review sources that feed reviews in. Open one by its id or slug.

useCases.title: Read the responses to a survey
useCases.text: List the customer or employee surveys. Page through the responses to one survey, newest or oldest first.

useCases.title: Look up or create a customer contact
useCases.text: Look up contacts by e-mail address. Create a contact, or update it when the e-mail address exists. The contact is not added to a list, so no survey invite is sent.

useCases.title: Import survey answers from another system
useCases.text: Read the import fields of a survey, then import answer rows. A repeated external_id updates that row. The organization needs the survey-answers import feature.

useCases.title: Set up a webhook to a URL you control
useCases.text: List the webhooks and read an example payload. Then create a webhook that sends events to your URL. Events include customer data.
